HOW TO USE IT

Fuel and hydrate like a pro

{{ first_name|default:'there' }}, a quick guide so your hydration works as
hard as you do.

Gels: one GO Isotonic gel every 20–30 minutes during long sessions; no water
needed.
Electrolytes: one Hydro tablet in 500ml water before and during hot sessions.
Rule: try new fuel in training, never for the first time on race day.

General guidance, not medical advice. Follow the label and speak to your
doctor if you have a medical condition.
